bio.text: Larry Suckla, a Republican, represents District 58 in the Colorado House of Representatives, covering Delta, Dolores, Gunnison, Hinsdale, Montezuma, Montrose, Ouray and San Miguel counties.
He has held the seat since January 2025, succeeding Marc Catlin, and is a candidate in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He graduated from Montezuma Cortez High School and has worked as a farmer, rancher, auctioneer, small business owner, cook and truck driver.
